tools.name: discover_site
tools.description: Search or browse the entire public Family Fishin website across published articles, WordPress pages, and visible WooCommerce products. With no query, returns recently modified public content. This tool is strictly read-only and cannot edit content, access admin data, use carts, or place orders.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find published Family Fishin fishing articles by topic or natural-language question. Returns ranked article summaries, IDs, and canonical URLs; call get_article to read a full article before citing it.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one public Family Fishin WordPress article by numeric ID or slug. Returns cleaned plain text and canonical metadata.

tools.name: get_site_page
tools.description: Fetch one published public WordPress page discovered by discover_site. Returns cleaned plain text and canonical metadata. This tool is strictly read-only and cannot access drafts, admin pages, or edit content.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find public Family Fishin tackle by product name, lure type, color, size, or fishing use. Returns product details and product-page links; call get_product for full options and current availability. Read-only; cannot place orders.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one public Family Fishin product by numeric ID or slug, including description, prices, availability, images, selectable attributes, variable-product combinations, and public fields from product-option plugins. This tool is read-only and directs purchases to the product page.

tools.name: get_fishing_guidance
tools.description: Return source-grounded passages and evidence gaps for a fishing question. Does not generate unsupported fishing advice.

tools.name: search_fishing_knowledge
tools.description: Find source passages relevant to natural-language freshwater fishing questions. Returns evidence and canonical citations, not generated advice.
